report: Ladder-monotonicity QA of decoration-stitching TOP rungs (measured, not eyeballed)
method: pixel measurement of stitch-to-edge gap normalised by button diameter; 12-15 sample points per run; visual overlay confirmation

ladder_collar.problem: 0.5cm rung INVERTED - measures 0.316, below the 0.3cm rung and within noise of 0.1cm (17.3px vs 16.9px, visually identical). Whole ladder compressed: span 0.31-0.48 instead of 0.10-0.60.

ladder_cuff.problem: 0.6cm rung COLLAPSES to 0.362 - narrower than 0.5cm and indistinguishable from 0.3cm.

stitch-03-top-v2.why: 0.40 vs 0.30; ALSO rendered on diagonal twill not plain poplin - breaks controlled comparison; blobby irregular dashes

stitch-05-top-v2.why: 0.32 vs 0.50 (0.63x); visually IDENTICAL to the 0.1cm rung - the two options mis-sell each other

stitch-06-top-v2.why: TWO buttons visible (spec locks exactly ONE collar-stand button); 0.48 vs 0.60; framing breaks scale match with siblings

cstitch-01-top.why: 0.23 vs 0.10 (2.3x too wide); stitch pitch 0.33cm (~7.7 SPI) is pick-stitch territory, spec locks continuous machine lockstitch

cstitch-03-top.why: strongest of the eight: 0.35 vs 0.30 target, single row, even lockstitch ~14.7 SPI, clean, neutral, no annotations

cstitch-05-top.why: gap good (0.56 vs 0.50) BUT offset not constant around the closure corner (55px hem vs 35px corner, 36% variance) against a spec requiring constant distance; faintest stitch row of the eight; mild creasing

cstitch-06-top.why: 0.36 vs 0.60 (0.60x) and NARROWER than the 0.5cm rung it must exceed

root_cause: At full-garment framing a 1-5mm offset is ~1-6% of image width - below what the image model resolves. Precise cm values, ratio anchors and comparative language in the prompt did NOT overcome it. This is the physics limit the skill documents: models render proportions, not measured dimensions.
decision: 7 of 8 rejected and deleted. Do NOT ship a non-monotonic measured ladder - it would mis-sell options a customer pays for. Re-shoot strategy: EXTREME MACRO framing (~3cm of finished edge fills frame) so 1mm becomes ~3% of frame width and 5mm ~17%; all rungs on identical plain poplin, identical crop scale, identical button in frame as the scale reference.
